digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite / dribbling stall detection
propositions: Scheduler-delayed wake-ups in the shared fake-remote dribble fixture reduce actual throughput below the advertised rate, causing libcurl to abort valid transfers during scheduling gaps.
The test suite applies the same 2-second artificial stall window to both zero-byte positive controls and above-floor negative controls, making the latter non-deterministic under full-suite load.
A pure deterministic unit test of cumulative bytes-owed calculation must prove that delayed wake-up catch-up works correctly without relying on scheduler timing.

The fix requires splitting test windows: keep 2-second for zero-byte stall detection, use production 10-second window for one real Git/libcurl integration test, and remove redundant dribble timing trials at wrapper call sites.
git_fetch.py production code must remain unchanged; only test structure and window configuration are modified.
